LogAnalysis: At 2021/07/05 00:04, mobservice1 triggered a critical incident characterized by a surge of 12 NullPointerExceptions in the OrderProcessingService module within 2 minutes. Concurrently, the PaymentGateway microservice experienced DatabaseConnectionTimeout errors, indicating significant database scalability issues. This cascade resulted in repeated HTTP 503 ServiceUnavailable responses, severely impacting system availability. RootCauseAnalysis: The incident was caused by an unexpected termination of mobservice1, which failed to complete critical processing before exiting. This premature shutdown disrupted dependent workflows and propagated errors across the system. The service lacked adequate error handling and did not maintain state persistence to recover from interruptions.
